description: Projectiles enemies fire. Stage 3 reuses them as spells.

noita_file.desc: Projectile entity XML in data.wak (from the enemy's attack_ranged_entity_file).

sprite.desc: Sprite (png or sprite xml) in data.wak.

speed.desc: Launch speed, Terraria pixels per frame.

audio.desc: Folder of the projectile's Noita sound events (create/destroy), or 'none'.

explosion_sound.desc: Noita sound event of its explosion (config_explosion audio_event_name), or 'none'.

effect.desc: Status or special effect on hit.

terrain.desc: What it does to blocks (stage 2 physics).
